description: This file defines a comprehensive set of classes and functions for interacting with Microsoft Teams via the Microsoft Graph API. It includes tools for managing channels, chats, messages, reactions, and other Teams entities, with methods for listing, creating, updating, deleting, and performing various actions on these entities.

classes.name: BaseTeamsTool
classes.description: Abstract base class for Teams-related tools, providing common request and response formatting methods.

classes.name: ListChannelsTool
classes.description: Tool for listing all channels in a specified team.

classes.name: GetChannelTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving details of a specific channel.

classes.name: CreateChannelTool
classes.description: Tool for creating a new channel within a team.

classes.name: UpdateChannelTool
classes.description: Tool for updating properties of an existing channel.

classes.name: DeleteChannelTool
classes.description: Tool for deleting a channel from a team.

classes.name: ArchiveChannelTool
classes.description: Tool for archiving a channel.

classes.name: UnarchiveChannelTool
classes.description: Tool for unarchiving a channel.

classes.name: ListChannelMembersTool
classes.description: Tool for listing members of a channel.

classes.name: AddChannelMemberTool
classes.description: Tool for adding a member to a channel.

classes.name: RemoveChannelMemberTool
classes.description: Tool for removing a member from a channel.

classes.name: ListChatsTool
classes.description: Tool for listing all chats for the current user.

classes.name: GetChatTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving details of a specific chat.

classes.name: CreateChatTool
classes.description: Tool for creating a new chat.

classes.name: UpdateChatTool
classes.description: Tool for updating an existing chat.

classes.name: DeleteChatTool
classes.description: Tool for deleting a chat.

classes.name: ListChatMembersTool
classes.description: Tool for listing members of a chat.

classes.name: AddChatMemberTool
classes.description: Tool for adding a member to a chat.

classes.name: RemoveChatMemberTool
classes.description: Tool for removing a member from a chat.

classes.name: PinMessageTool
classes.description: Tool for pinning a message in a chat.

classes.name: UnpinMessageTool
classes.description: Tool for unpinning a message from a chat.

classes.name: ListMessagesTool
classes.description: Tool for listing messages in a chat or channel.

classes.name: GetMessageTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving details of a specific message.

classes.name: SendMessageTool
classes.description: Tool for sending a message to a chat or channel.

classes.name: UpdateMessageTool
classes.description: Tool for updating an existing message.

classes.name: DeleteMessageTool
classes.description: Tool for deleting a message.

classes.name: ReplyToMessageTool
classes.description: Tool for replying to a message.

classes.name: SetReactionTool
classes.description: Tool for setting a reaction on a message.

classes.name: UnsetReactionTool
classes.description: Tool for removing a reaction from a message.

classes.name: GetAllMessagesTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving messages across all chats and channels.

methods.name: makeGraphRequest
methods.description: Helper function to make requests to Microsoft Graph API.

methods.name: formatResponse
methods.description: Formats response data with additional parameters.

methods.name: createTeamsTools
methods.description: Factory function to create and return a list of Teams tools based on specified actions.
